description.value: East Café is a community-focused café built around the concept of the 'third place' — a welcoming space outside home and work where neighbours connect over coffee. It operates the City Smiles initiative, which has served over 3,200 free meals and drinks to homeless community members, and hosts weekly events including open mic nights, a book club, creative writing sessions, and Sunday jazz. The OSM node identifies this as the Marpole branch of the East Café brand, formerly operating as Gigi Blin.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record places this café at 1400 West 70th Avenue in Marpole, but every address signal on theeastcafe.com points to 2401 East Hastings Street (Hastings Sunrise neighbourhood), and the website's editorial text explicitly references 'the heart of Hastings Sunrise.' The website phone number (604-559-6400) also contradicts the OSM phone (+1 604-563-2100), and the contact email is info@grizzlycoffee.com — a roaster brand not reflected in the OSM name. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, washrooms, water refill) are mentioned anywhere in the website content, and amenity tags in OSM are limited to outdoor_seating=sidewalk.
concerns: Address mismatch: OSM node shows 1400 West 70th Avenue (Marpole, V6P 2Z2), but theeastcafe.com displays 2401 East Hastings Street (Hastings Sunrise, V5K 1Y8) — these are distinct Vancouver neighbourhoods several kilometres apart.
Phone mismatch: OSM lists +1 604-563-2100; website contact pages show (604) 559-6400.
Website contact email is info@grizzlycoffee.com, referencing a 'Grizzly Coffee' brand not mentioned in the OSM record.
Website editorial content explicitly references 'the heart of Hastings Sunrise,' confirming the site is for the East Hastings location, not Marpole.
It is unclear whether any café currently operates at 1400 West 70th Avenue under the East Café or Gigi Blin name; the OSM URL may be incorrectly assigned to this node.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The website linked in OSM (theeastcafe.com) consistently shows a completely different address (2401 East Hastings Street) and phone number than the OSM node (1400 West 70th Avenue, 604-563-2100); the site's own text confirms it represents the Hastings Sunrise location. Whether a functioning café currently operates at the Marpole address under this brand cannot be confirmed from available evidence.
enrichment_extras.notes: If an East Café location does operate at 1400 West 70th Ave, it likely has distinct contact details. The OSM website tag for this node should be investigated and potentially corrected or removed.
